review_role: independent technical code review of root CLI integration; core/adapter original author disclosed
scope: CLI mandatory release boundary, deterministic diagnostic subset/resume identity, exact checkpoint binding, immutable sampling bytes, atomic label publication and explicit test-double adaptations. No new clinical review or approval.

findings.finding: Training hashed series bytes but reparsed the mutable path, permitting the metadata used by StudyDataset to differ from authenticated bytes.
findings.discovery: static initial integration review; root fixed before an old-version runtime reproduction
findings.verification: A synthetic concurrent-path replacement occurs inside read_csv; StudyDataset still receives the original authenticated feature values from BytesIO.

findings.finding: Inference validated nested release identity but did not reject conflicting present top-level checkpoint manifest/series/source identities.
findings.discovery: static initial integration review; root acknowledged and fixed
findings.verification: Three synthetic conflicting-identity cases fail before dataset access or output. Public-test mode requires no training data. Duplicated legacy top-level fields may be absent in public mode, while the nested release identity stays mandatory.

findings.finding: The metadata helper selected a preliminary split before full release validation, although that selection was discarded before dataset use. No supervision bypass was demonstrated.
findings.verification: A sentinel full-boundary test confirms labeled inference reaches complete release validation before the metadata selection helper.

other_checks: labels rejects pre-existing outputs and stages all files in a temporary sibling directory before rename
actual synthetic release fixture injects failure after receipt creation and before lineage completion; neither destination nor temporary partial release survives
full manifest release validation precedes diagnostic subsetting and resume loading
diagnostic selection sorted by UID only after original leakage/group checks; count and UID digests plus limit enter run_config and metrics
resume requires exact release binding and run_config; diagnostic metrics are explicitly marked
legacy policy tests use opt-in fixtures only; no production bypass or automatic fallback was introduced
new real-boundary tests restore the actual loader when checking missing receipt failures

verification.mocks: Only unrelated full release policy/optimizer boundaries are isolated in focused snapshot/order tests. Atomic labels test uses the actual-validator synthetic fixture and creates a real verified receipt before injected lineage failure.
